chunks: They wish you to become disbelievers as they are, so that you should become like them. Therefore hold them not as friends until they go out of their homes in the way of God. If they do not, seize them wherever they are and do away with them. Do not make them your friends or allies,
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for taking disbelievers as allies according to Surah An-Nisa verse 89?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the principle of *al-wala' wa al-barra'* (loyalty and disavowal), emphasizing that true alliance with disbelievers is contingent upon their active migration (*hijrah*) for God's sake. It serves as a foundational text for distinguishing the community of believers from those who are content with their own disbelief, linking spiritual distinctiveness to physical and political separation.
